points.evidence: The letter's Performance Update section reports Q2 net (-3.36%), the comparison index (-2.95%), trailing 12 months (6.18%), and Q2 gross (-3.16%), but contains no year-to-date figure. The phrase 'Over the past year, your mandate has delivered 6.18% net of fees' corresponds to the trailing 12-month return, not the 0.92% year-to-date net return, which is omitted entirely.
